title: Seattle Chillhop 🚆
description:
Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated Seattle on a rainy autumn afternoon: the skyline and the Space Needle over Puget Sound, a red-brick lighthouse, the Pike Place Market clock, the waterfront wheel and Mount Rainier faint in the mist, with evergreens, orange maples and gentle rain, set to mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "After Hours" and "Turbulence" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.

#lofi #seattle #trainride #chillhop #rainyday
